Business Summary#

Long-standing, reputable fireplace retailer and installation business operating in a thriving downtown area in Eastern Iowa. The Business offers a wide selection of fireplaces, inserts, stoves, grills, gas logs, and accessories to consumers, home builders, and interior designers in the area.

Facilities#

12,600+ sq. ft. showroom, shipping/receiving, warehousing, workshop with 20 parking spaces located within a downtown retail and office assemblage built in 2005.

Market Pros#

The Business is the largest retailer of fireplaces in Eastern Iowa. 

Support & Training  #

The seller is willing to provide consulting to the new owner for 3 months.

Reason for Selling  #

Retirement.
